public_rationale: Marcus says that, as far as he can tell, hardly anyone believed Altman's safety reason for pausing some frontier RL training. Coverage confirms that some analysts doubted it and suspected cost-cutting or compute limits ahead of an IPO. The same coverage also presents the safety incidents behind the pause at face value. I found no count, poll, or systematic review of reactions. So I cannot tell whether nearly everyone doubted it or just a vocal subset. The hedge 'as far as I can tell' also makes this partly a report of his own impression.
limitations: Could not read X replies directly.
Self-selected social-media replies would not be representative anyway.
The hedge limits how far the claim can be tested.
